title: [FEATURE] JetBrains need some love - a real Claude AI Assist interface plugin
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet - [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features) ### Problem Statement I often use AI Assist like in-built Jetbrains, Junie, etc but now they all require subscription to use my Claude Pro. I installed "Claude Code [Beta]" plugin and it's just a basically a terminal interface with no ability to "add file" or "add reference" inside an editor, as well, couldn't correct my sentence by using a mouse. It's annoying to be forced to move terminal to the sidebar to use Claude Code as a sidebar because I prefer to leave terminal on bottom of the screen. It's not possible to have both Claude Code on sidebar and the terminal on the bottom, until Claude developers an actual plugin that don't open the Jetbrains terminal. Other people have opened this similar issue but it got closed due to 7 days inactivity. I would like to know if Claude team is working on it and taking this seriously because a lot of developers use Jetbrains. It's not some niche editor for small base of developers, a lot of developers do use Jetbrains too. ### Proposed Solution I would like the "real" interface plugin to be available for Jetbrains (I'm using WebStorm) instead of just a terminal. VSCode has received this type of love, it's similar to AI assist/Junie which require another pro membership in order to use Claude API with input bar, `+ context picker` and `/` command bar. An ability to use a terminal on bottom of the screen instead of the sidebar, currently, Claude Code [Beta] uses a Jetbrain terminal and I'm forced to move it to the sidebar and all terminals would be on sidebars too. It's not possible to have a terminal on bottom and the Claude Code on the sidebar in the current state. **I've seen other issues regarding this but they all got closed. Are Claude working on this interface so Jetbrains would get the same love as VSCode receive?** Thanks. ### Alternative Solutions _No response_ ### Priority High - Significant impact on productivity ### Feature Category Developer tools/SDK ### Use Case Example _No response_ ### Additional Context # Screenshots **(Happy) VSCode interface:** **(Sad) Jetbrains "Claude Code [Beta] interface:**
